cabinCategories.description: Celebrity Edge interior stateroom — refined design, premium linens, and spa-inspired bath amenities set Celebrity apart from the crowd.
Edge Stateroom with infinite veranda — Celebrity's revolutionary design blurs the line between inside and out, transforming your room into a glass-enclosed outdoor space.
AquaClass stateroom with veranda — includes spa-focused amenities, daily access to the Persian Garden, and exclusive seating at Blu restaurant.
The Retreat Sky Suite — butler service, dedicated Retreat Host, private Retreat sundeck with pool, and exclusive Luminae restaurant reserved for suite guests.

exclusions: Specialty dining (Fine Cut, Eden, Raw on 5)
inclusions: All meals in main dining room and Oceanview Café

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Celebrity Edge — Celebrity's revolutionary Edge-class ship — departs on a refined 7-night Alaska voyage.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital offers everything from helicopter glacier tours to local craft breweries. Take the Mount Roberts Tramway for panoramic views or whale watch in Auke Bay.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: Surrounded by dramatic mountains, Skagway preserves Gold Rush history in its National Historic District. The White Pass Railway is a must for first-time visitors.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: A full day of breathtaking scenic cruising through Glacier Bay. Celebrity Edge's Edge Staterooms offer an extraordinary front-row seat to Alaska's glacial majesty.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: World's largest collection of standing totem poles, historic Creek Street, and outstanding fresh seafood make Ketchikan an Alaska highlight.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: A sophisticated evening in British Columbia's elegant capital. Butchart Gardens or high tea at the Fairmont Empress round off the Alaska voyage perfectly.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: Celebrity's design-forward ship with Infinite Veranda staterooms and the cantilevered Magic Carpet — a polished, upscale-feeling choice for couples who want modern style and strong dining.

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 for Celebrity Edge's final Alaska sailing of 2027, ending in Vancouver.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Morning scenic cruising to Dawes Glacier.
portsOfCall.name: Endicott Arm & Dawes Glacier
